Vivian spearheaded our latest SaaS product launch, pivoting the roadmap mid-sprint after user feedback showed 40% drop-off in onboarding retention. She rerouted resources to build a guided setup flow, which increased active users by 22% in Q3. Her ability to balance agility with strategic priorities kept the team aligned during chaos.  

We’ve collaborated daily on cross-team initiatives, from integrating threat intel APIs to optimizing incident response workflows. Vivian’s knack for distilling complex security requirements into actionable tasks made her a linchpin in our 12-person product team. She’s the first to volunteer for late-night troubleshooting sessions, always prioritizing customer impact over process.  

Her strength lies in turning raw data into decisions. Once, she used SQL to analyze 50k+ logs, identifying a 30% gap in detection coverage. This led to a roadmap shift prioritizing endpoint detection, which boosted our product’s TPR by 18% in 90 days. She also excels at aligning stakeholders—whether negotiating with engineering leads or translating security needs into business value for executives.  

Vivian’s blend of technical rigor and empathy makes her a rare asset. She’s equally comfortable deep-diving into code reviews as she is crafting stakeholder presentations. Her work ethic is unmatched; she’ll stay late to refine a dashboard in Tableau until it’s perfect, then pivot to help a teammate debug a production issue.  

I’m confident she’ll bring the same level of ownership and precision to any team. Her curiosity and ability to turn ambiguity into clarity are unmatched.
